item.title: Show HN: Pianoterm – Run shell commands from your Piano. A Linux CLI tool
item.description:
📝 pianoterm Run shell commands from your piano Description Linux CLI tool to assign shell commands to keys on a USB MIDI Keyboard Usage pianoterm <port> Note: Assumes ALSA is used as the soundcard driver Use acconnect -i to find the desired midi port Configuration $HOME/. config/pianoterm/config # this is a comment # # trigger can be on_release or on_press on_press # syntax: port = command # use aseqdump -p <port> to find specific keycodes 21 = playerctl previous # first key on an 88-key keyboard 22 = playerctl play-pause 23 = playerctl next #. com/vustagc/pianoterm.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/vustagc/pianoterm
